name: MeshCentral
description: MeshCentral is a free, open-source, self-hosted remote management server. Through a small agent you get remote desktop, terminal, file transfer and power control for Windows, Linux and macOS devices, all in the browser. Uses the official image ghcr.io/ylianst/meshcentral. Before the first start: set Server name (HOSTNAME) to the DNS name or IP that agents and browsers use. Keep the HTTPS host port, its container port and PORT the same number: MeshCentral tells the agents to connect to the port it listens on. Then open https://[Server name]:8443, using exactly the Server name: MeshCentral refuses other names and the bare IP with "Invalid origin" after login. The WebUI button uses the IP, so it only works when HOSTNAME is the IP. The first account you create becomes the administrator. DYNAMIC_CONFIG=true writes the values of this template into config.json at every start. Set it to false if you prefer to edit appdata/meshcentral/data/config.json by hand.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: config.json, certificates and the built-in database. Back this up.

paths.name: Files
paths.description: Files stored on the server through the web UI.

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: Server backups (when autoBackup is enabled in config.json).

paths.name: Web
paths.description: Custom web pages and themes. Can stay empty.

ports.name: HTTPS port
ports.description: Web UI and agent connections. Host port, container port and PORT must be the same number.

ports.name: HTTP port
ports.description: Plain HTTP, redirects to HTTPS. Any free host port.

variables.name: Server name (HOSTNAME)
variables.description: DNS name or IP that agents and browsers use to reach this server, e.g. mesh.example.com. Used for the server certificate and built into every agent installer.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Port MeshCentral listens on and tells the agents. Must match the HTTPS port above.

variables.name: DYNAMIC_CONFIG
variables.description: true: write the values of this template into config.json at every start. false: config.json is only created once and then left alone.

variables.name: ALLOW_NEW_ACCOUNTS
variables.description: Let anyone create an account on the login page. The first account is always allowed and becomes the administrator.

variables.name: WEBRTC
variables.description: Use WebRTC for direct connections between browser and agent.

variables.name: ALLOW_PLUGINS
variables.description: Enable MeshCentral plugins.

variables.name: IFRAME
variables.description: Allow the web UI to be embedded in an iframe.

variables.name: MINIFY
variables.description: Serve minified web pages.

variables.name: LOCAL_SESSION_RECORDING
variables.description: Allow recording of remote sessions.

variables.name: REVERSE_PROXY
variables.description: Public name of a reverse proxy in front of MeshCentral, e.g. mesh.example.com. MeshCentral loads the proxy certificate from there so agents trust it. See the README.

variables.name: REVERSE_PROXY_TLS_PORT
variables.description: HTTPS port of the reverse proxy.

variables.name: TLS_OFFLOAD
variables.description: IP of the reverse proxy when it terminates TLS and talks plain HTTP to MeshCentral. Leave EMPTY otherwise: any value, even false, switches TLS off.

variables.name: TRUSTED_PROXY
variables.description: Trust X-Forwarded-For from: all, or one IP in double quotes, e.g. "172.17.0.1".

variables.name: INSTALL_STYLISHUI
variables.description: Download and install the third-party Stylish UI theme at every start.

variables.name: USE_MONGODB
variables.description: Use MongoDB instead of the built-in database (recommended for many devices).

variables.name: MONGO_URL
variables.description: e.g. mongodb://user:password@192.168.1.10:27017/meshcentral

variables.name: USE_MARIADB
variables.description: Use MariaDB/MySQL instead of the built-in database.

variables.name: MARIADB_HOST
variables.description: MariaDB server name or IP.

variables.name: MARIADB_PORT
variables.description: MariaDB port.

variables.name: MARIADB_USER
variables.description: MariaDB user.

variables.name: MARIADB_PASS
variables.description: MariaDB password.

variables.name: MARIADB_DATABASE
variables.description: MariaDB database name.

variables.name: USE_POSTGRESQL
variables.description: Use PostgreSQL instead of the built-in database.

variables.name: PSQL_HOST
variables.description: PostgreSQL server name or IP.

variables.name: PSQL_PORT
variables.description: PostgreSQL port.

variables.name: PSQL_USER
variables.description: PostgreSQL user.

variables.name: PSQL_PASS
variables.description: PostgreSQL password.

variables.name: PSQL_DATABASE
variables.description: PostgreSQL database name.
